leadText: Kangaskhan and Mr. Kogusuri (Japanese: ガルーラと小薬さん and Mr. Kogusuri) is the fourth episode of A Pocketful of Adventures. It first aired in Japan on November 9, 2023, and in the Middle East and North Africa on May 18, 2024.
